execution: private server only; local client hashes and streams source bytes
paper_identity: Normalized first-page title, or exact arXiv banner plus title-token recall >= 0.8; title must precede abstract/introduction. Other cases require review.
unicode: NFKD; fold case; join hyphenated line endings; compare whitespace-free title for small caps
page_number_basis: Physical PDF pages including blank pages
embedding_config: Unchanged existing Jina config; this extraction does not compute embeddings.
